comments.author: xyst
comments.story: I Fixed a Parasitic Drain on My Car in 408 Days
comments.text: Personal vehicles are getting way too complicated now. Too many electronic components that can be points of failure. Recently viewed a video on “steer by wire yoke” [VIDEO] It’s very interesting but there are so many additional motors, sensors, and actuators to simulate the same experience as mechanical based steering. If you lose electronic assistance in traditional mechanical based steering, you have to apply more force as a driver and makes the experience difficult. What happens if I lose one or more components in this “steer by wire yoke”? Seems like as a driver you are shit out of luck. If you are a pedestrian, bye bye. All I want is a walkable city with public and alternative forms of transportation. All of these “car innovations” are mostly useless.
